note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SLN 10-15; A06b SLN 10-15; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships (with major exceptions); a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Dual citizenship restriction), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a dual-citizenship restriction on descent, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Slovenia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Slovenia for 10 years, of which 5 were continuous, and with a 'settled status' immediately before the application. ... Evidence of renunciation of citizenship of another country (unless the person is stateless or when renunciation is legally impossible or unreasonable) required. Renunciation is not required for nationals of EU Member States if reciprocity applies. ... n.a. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Slovenia to a citizen. ... Dual citizenship restriction ... Person is born abroad to a citizen and a parent who is unknown, of unknown citizenship or without citizenship, or when the child would otherwise be stateless.; Person is born abroad to a citizen and a citizen of another country, is between 18 and 36 years of age, and has not previously lost citizenship due to release, renunciation or deprivation. ... No provision ... No provision
